gate_definitions.scaled_czech_absolute_area: 20/9 to 700/9 source px²; Czech-developed absolute contour gate scaled by resolution area
gate_definitions.past_cap_area_0p33_to_3: next contour area between 1/3 and 3 times last observed source cap area
gate_definitions.past_cap_area_0p5_to_2: next contour area between 1/2 and 2 times last observed source cap area
gate_definitions.past_cap_area_0p75_to_1p5: next contour area between 3/4 and 1.5 times last observed source cap area
gate_definitions.no_area_limit_diagnostic: all raw colour contours in the search ROI

limitations: Relative-size gates were considered after inspecting the 2022 failure; these are in-sample diagnostic variants, not a frozen transfer result.
A next-frame colour contour matching a past cap size and motion can still be a different stone, player, graphic or tracking splice.
The comparison uses existing shot-scoped cap tracks, not independently labelled physical throws or complete game states.
No variant should be promoted without source-pixel error review and independent cross-camera validation.
